x_note: Pure RL assist controller (Documents/RL/DieuKhien_RL.txt). Read by Model/load_rl.m (block parameters) and by Model/RL/script/rl_env.m and train_rl.m (agent and training). Observation spacing and size: section 2.1a of the RL document (chosen by the user). Reward, termination, discount, network training, exploration, curriculum and the low-pass observation of e_T: chosen by Claude for Train1 (section 2.4a) and revised for Train2 (section 2.4b), with the reasons in those sections; provisional.

Ts_agent.desc: Agent sample time (decision period), same as the Map and PID controllers

obs_signals.desc: Measured signals fed to the agent (Blueprint 1.2), in this order

obs_scale.desc: Normalization: observation = signal / scale (N.m, N.m, rad, rad/s, m/s, rad/s, m/s^2); a_y scale = 0.4 g, v scale = 100 km/h; provisional

n_hist.desc: Current sample plus n_hist-1 previous samples of every signal; window = (n_hist-1)*hist_stride*Ts_agent = 20 ms

hist_stride.desc: Spacing D between the history samples in agent samples (5 = 5 ms): the signals used to estimate the rate of change of T_s must be far enough apart to stay above the sensor quantization noise

Ta_scale.desc: Normalization of the previous assist torque observation = max T_a,max(v)

I_tau.desc: Time constant of the slow observation I = low-pass filter of the MEASURED e_T: I[k+1] = (1 - Ts/tau)*I[k] + (Ts/tau)*e_T[k]. About the 1.3 s time scale of T_s after a mu change (measured). Equivalent to a leaky integral of e_T divided by tau

I_scale.desc: Normalization of the slow observation I (same scale as e_T)

T_ref.desc: Scale in r = -(e_T/T_ref)^2 - w1*(T_a[k-1]-T_a[k-2])^2 - w2*T_a[k-1]^2 (e_T TRUE): keeps the discounted return of order 10, a range the critic network learns well

w1.desc: Smoothness weight chosen so that the smoothness of the Map (mean (dT_a)^2 per 1 ms sample about 0.33 on the Train1 validation episode) costs as much as a tracking error of 0.1 N.m: (0.1/T_ref)^2 / 0.33 = 3e-4 (Train1 used 0.01, which made smoothness 30 to 12000 times heavier than tracking for Map and PID)

w2.desc: Weight of the assist-torque magnitude: 0 (no reason to penalize the assist itself)

done_eT.desc: Early termination switched off (threshold unreachable): 10 N.m cut untrained episodes after 61 steps (step 1); episodes are 10 s long instead

use_agent.desc: 1: T_a from the agent; 0: T_a = 0 (wiring check with the open-loop plant)

dTa_max.desc: Variant C (Documents/RL/DieuKhien_RL.txt section 2.4d): the agent outputs dT_a within +-dTa_max and T_a[k] = sat(T_a[k-1] + dT_a): the integral action is in the structure, and dTa_max is a built-in rate limit of 200 N.m/s (7.5 N.m in 37 ms). T_a[k-1] is the value AFTER the T_a,max clamp, so the integration stops by itself in saturation (anti-windup). Used only by the model Model_RLinc_s

gamma.desc: Discount factor: horizon about 1/(1-gamma) = 1000 steps = 1 s, close to the 1.3 s time scale of T_s after a mu change

actor_lr.desc: Actor learning rate (slower than the critic, as in DDPG/TD3 practice)

critic_lr.desc: Critic learning rate, 10 times smaller than in Train1 (1e-3): the training reward collapsed after about 25 episodes, a typical sign of a diverging critic

grad_threshold.desc: Gradient clipping threshold of both optimizers

buffer.desc: Experience buffer length = 1000 s of driving = the last 100 episodes

noise_corr_time_s.desc: Correlation time of the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck exploration noise: white noise at 1 kHz would be filtered out by the steering column, so the noise must last tens of ms

noise_std_start.desc: Stationary std of the exploration noise at the start (about 4% of the +-7.8 N.m action range)

noise_decay_steps.desc: Steps over which the noise std decays from start to min (exponential)

chunk_episodes.desc: Episodes per call of train(); after every chunk the progress, validation and agents are written to Result/RL/<run>

trial_episodes.desc: First 2e5 steps = trial: the log records whether the validation cost improved

curriculum_stage1_episodes.desc: Episodes in stage 1 of the curriculum: dry road, no friction change, smaller lateral acceleration (rl_scenario_random.m)

curriculum_stage2_episodes.desc: Episodes in stage 2: mild friction changes (mu1 0.4-0.8); stage 3 (full range) follows

max_hours.desc: Wall-clock budget of the training run (Train1: 3.5 h gave only 110 episodes)

max_steps.desc: Step budget of the training run

rng_seed.desc: Seed of the MATLAB random generator (network init, scenario and noise seeds drawn per episode); 2 so that Train2 does not replay the Train1 draws
